Good evening, Kotora-san! Looking forward to working with you again this season ✨ With the 2026 season opening soon, I'd like to request an illustration. Takumi Kuriyama, who has dedicated his entire career to the Lions, has announced his retirement after the 2026 season... making this his final year 😭 So, I'd like to request an illustration of Tsukimori in the style of Takumi Kuriyama...

The image I have in mind is him in his uniform, wearing number 1, heading from the on-deck circle to the batter's box. He's holding his bat in his left hand, and his right hand is tossing a spray can behind him (the spray can is floating in the air). He's looking slightly back and to the right. I would be so grateful if you could capture this moment for me🙇🏻‍♀️՞

If you search for "Kuriyama-san can toss," you might get a feel for the vibe 💦 If possible, I'd also love it if you could add the text "LAST ONE" (meaning one more year and his number 1) in any available space. I apologize for the vague description, but I truly appreciate your help 🙏✨

婿川コトラ様
初めまして、おにぎりと申します。
以前よりXにて素敵なイラストを拝見しており、是非ともイラストの作成をお願いしたくご依頼を送らせていただきます。

・要望
Vtuberの叶恋さんのイラストを描いて欲しいです。近々YouTubeでの活動開始1周年となるのでそちらをお祝いするイラストを描いて頂けたら幸いです。
1st anniversaryの文字は入れていただきたいです。表情、ポーズや構図等はお任せしますのでご自由に描いてください。

またSNS等へのアップロードは可能でしょうか？

内容が合わなければキャンセルしていただいて大丈夫です。
お忙しいなか恐れ入りますが、ご検討よろしくお願いいたします。

拙い文章で申し訳ありませんがよろしくお願いします。
